sites.name: Woods Lake Campground
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Woods Lake Campground is a tent-only campground near the summit of Carson Pass. At 8,200 feet, it is often the last to open each season. Woods Lake offers opportunities for fishing, swimming, paddleboarding, and non-motorized boating such as kayaking. Trails lead from the campground into Mokelumne…
sites.directions: 63.5 miles east of Jackson on Highway 88 and 2 miles south of the highway near Carson Pass.
